title: Someone Calls In Sick at 6 AM: Now What?

scenes.say: Six oh two in the morning. Ana's sick. Who covers?

scenes.speaker: Ana
scenes.say: So sorry, I've got a fever. I can't come in. Feel better, Ana. We've got it.

messages.text: So sorry, I've got a fever
Feel better, Ana. We've got it.

scenes.say: This is where a plan beats a panic. A short list of who can cover, already agreed. Leo comes in early, and Saturday is covered.
So: keep an on-call list for every shift. Agree what a short-staffed day looks like, like a smaller menu. And never make the sick person find their own cover.
